Handoff documents exist in this repo (`.session-handoff/`, or legacy `handoffs/`). A resume-shaped request — "continue from last session", "resume", "pick up where we left off" — routes to the `session-handoff` skill's resume workflow (freshness check, red flags, prune), even when it arrives mid-session. An injected memory digest is background context, not the resume workflow; never treat it as a substitute for invoking the skill.
